traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Emotional life meets disruption and the need for freedom. Feelings turn unpredictable, restless, and resistant to routine. The trine makes this a natural strength: Emotional independence and a quick, inventive instinct; at ease with change. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Feeling and disruption flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and disruption have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Good for inventive moves and breaking stale routines; poor for steady, predictable handling.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
